decisions.reason: The air quality sensor module has its own page and dedicated development investment, and it fits the announced expansion of the modular sensor platform, so it is likely kept.
As the new generation replacing the Analog In Bricklet 2.0, the voltage module was publicly committed to as the successor, and dropping it would expose that decision as a mistake.
The MQTT proxy extends the core software-binding strength the firm announced and costs little to maintain, so there is no reason to drop it.
The CAN bus module has only modest visibility, but it broadens the connectivity options central to the platform, and its weak early results can be attributed to a temporary ramp-up.
The CO2 sensor module has its own page and invested development, and it fits the sensing direction, so management will persist with it.
The touch panel accessory is less central than the modules, but its dedicated page and the money already spent on it favor continuing it as a complementary item.
